tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// thogs med sku mched sogs la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// tshul khrims lhun po yon tan ljon shing gis// legs spras blo gsal ri dwags tshogs rnams dang*// grub pa'i drang srong rnams kyi bsti gnas mchog /chos rje dpal ldan ri bo'i zhabs la 'dud// mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i shing rta can// shes bya'i mkha' la kun tu thogs med cing*// bstan pa padmo'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa// thogs med chos kyi nyi ma la phyag 'tshal// bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs par 'khrungs// blo gros klu dbang thos pa'i nor gyis phyug /legs bshad char gyis 'gro kun smin mdzad pa// dbyig gnyen klu yi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// khyod thugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsal mdzad pas// shes bya'i kun la mkhyen pa rab rgyas shing*// mkhas mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// dpal ldan phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs la 'dud// blo gros lus brjid tshul khrims ral bas mdzes// rnam dpyod mig ldan rigs pa'i mche sder gyis// phyir rgol dregs pa glang po'i klad 'gems pa// chos kyi grags pa 'jigs med seng ge rgyal// tshul khrims rnam dag mang du gsan pa can// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyis rjes bzung zhing*// zhi zhing dul ba shākya'i rgyal po'i sras// dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod thugs bskal pa du mar rab sbyangs pas// shes bya ma lus ji bzhin yongs su mkhyen// skad gnyis smra ba gangs can gsal mdzad pa// rin chen bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i khams dang mkha' dang bar snang sa gzhi'i gtos kun gsal byed pa'i// legs bshad gsung zer tsha zer byed pa'i 'od zer lta bu nye bar 'bar ba rab 'phros pas// rgya mtsho'i gos can mthas gtugs rgya mtsho lta bur kun nas snyoms shing yangs pa'i gzhir// blo chen rjes 'brang blo yi nor ldan blo gros padmo kun nas rgyas byed de la 'dud//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
